items.title: Louis Barbarin Interview, 1960-06-22
items.q: And as a recording, they made the number by the name of Zozi. He'd taken the number after the name of his wife.

ctx.x: They were on Canal between Charters and upstairs, yeah. And the same boy, Albert Snide, we had the band there. We went up to make a recording. And as a recording, they made the number by the name of Zozi. He'd taken the number after the name of his wife. This Ilius name he gave his wife Zozi. And they recorded one side, I don't know what ever become of it. Never recorded the other side of the record. I don't
